responsibility: Declares the low-level data structures and helpers for structural dumping of GCC tree nodes. It defines dump_info, dump queue/node records, dump flags for queued references, the dump_child convenience macro, and the primitive formatting and index-queueing routines used by tree-dump.cc to print tree graphs with stable node numbering.
same_name_distinction: Defines the dump_info/dump_queue support types, flags, macro helpers, and primitive interfaces for structural tree dumping that tree-dump.cc uses to implement the actual dumper.
